summary: 43 engine tests and 34 browser checks pass. Three review rounds (two simulated teachers, a cold-build auditor, three simulated students) found blocking and major problems; each was repaired and the students' real replies are replayed as regression tests. An independent evaluator is now judging the contract against the evidence. Word-based matching remains the main weakness.

Student runtime: Preparation, Practice (Roleplay or Teachback, optional 3D cave field work), Feedback with self-assessment, citations and transfer
Adaptation tied to criteria and evidence; answer-seeking declined; misconceptions probed
Persistence and resume; export / import; teacher view of sessions, evidence and adaptations
Two bundled cross-domain sample experiences produced through the authoring steps
